# homeassistant_integration_options (Resource)

The options of a config entry, set through its options flow: the settings behind "Configure" on the integration's page, such as a threshold's limits or a utility meter's source sensor. The entry can come from the UI or from `homeassistant_integration`. Only the fields in `steps` are managed; the flow keeps every other option as it is. Home Assistant returns the current options only as the pre-filled values of the flow's first form, so each refresh starts the options flow and aborts it, which changes nothing; fields of later forms are not compared. Destroying the resource leaves the options as they are. Flows that start with a menu are not supported.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# A threshold helper created by Tofu. Its limits live in the options, so changing them later
# runs the options flow instead of replacing the entry.
resource "homeassistant_integration" "frost" {
  domain = "threshold"
  steps = {
    user = { name = "Frost", entity_id = "sensor.outdoor_temperature", lower = 0, hysteresis = 0 }
  }
}

# Each key of `steps` answers the options-flow form with that step_id. Only these fields are
# managed: the flow keeps every other option as it is.
resource "homeassistant_integration_options" "frost" {
  entry_id = homeassistant_integration.frost.id
  steps = {
    init = { lower = 2, hysteresis = 0.5 }
  }
}

# The options of an entry set up in the UI, e.g. a utility meter whose source sensor resets.
resource "homeassistant_integration_options" "water_meter" {
  entry_id = "01JABCDEF0123456789ABCDEFG"
  steps = {
    init = { periodically_resetting = true }
  }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `entry_id` (String) The config entry's `entry_id`, e.g. `homeassistant_integration.meter.id`. Changing it replaces the resource. Import with this ID.
- `steps` (Dynamic) The options to set, as an object from the options flow's `step_id` to the form's fields, e.g. `{ init = { upper = 20 } }`. Each form is answered with its current values, and the fields of the step with its `step_id` replace them; `null` unsets an optional field. A field the form does not have is an error. After an import, this holds every field of the first form.

### Read-Only

- `domain` (String) Integration domain of the config entry, e.g. `utility_meter`.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# Import the options of a config entry by its entry_id. The import reads every field of the
# options flow's first form into `steps`, so `tofu plan -generate-config-out=options.tf` writes a
# configuration that plans no changes. Leaving fields out later only stops managing them.
tofu import homeassistant_integration_options.frost 01JABCDEF0123456789ABCDEFG
```
